getLightState: Returns the current On/Off state and brightness of a light.; returns only
resetFilterStatus: Resets the filter life counter after a filter replacement.; filter, not a light
setAmbientLighting: Sets the color and brightness of the interior ambient lighting.; smart_car cabin only
setBrightness: Sets the brightness level (0-100%) for a dimmable light.; level only
setColor: Sets the color of a light using HSB (Hue/Saturation/Brightness) values.; smart_home hsb only
setColorTemperature: Adjusts the white light temperature (Kelvin) from warm to cool.; kelvin only, no color
setGroupLightState: Controls the state of a group of lights simultaneously.; a group, not one light
setLighting: Controls the power, brightness, and color of a light in a single command.; one light, not a group
